Automated Model Briefing

⚠ AI-generated text — may be wrong, incomplete, or overconfident. This is automated commentary on experimental model output, not flight advice and not a weather forecast. It has not been reviewed by a meteorologist.

Overall Assessment — A classic Great Basin thermal day with strong late-afternoon westerly winds. Thermals peak mid-afternoon (500–560 ft/min) with ceilings up to 7,400 ft AGL, but surface winds increase sharply after 14:00, over-powering many ridge sites. Best soaring windows are 11:30–14:00 before winds become too strong.

Site Breakdown

  • Kingsbury Grade: Marginal — Light early upslope winds turn strong W 25–29 mph after 15:00, exceeding preferred direction. Fly 11:00–14:00 for thermals to 4,400 ft AGL (peak 430 ft/min). Sharp thermal caution — lapse rate 9.2 °C/km.
  • Hallelujah: Favorable — Wind shifts on-favored W direction after 14:00 at 11–19 mph. Fly 11:30–17:00 for 500+ ft/min thermals to 6,600 ft AGL. Sharp thermal caution — lapse rate 10.0 °C/km (advanced pilots only).
  • Slide Mountain: Unfavorable — Wind stays 204°–230° all morning (off preferred SE), then builds W 20–23 mph in afternoon. Brief thermal window 10:00–14:00 to 3,600 ft AGL (405 ft/min).
  • McClellan: Favorable — Wind becomes on-favored SW by 12:00, then W 14–20 mph afternoon. Fly 12:00–15:00 for 540 ft/min thermals to 5,200 ft AGL. Sharp thermal caution — lapse rate 9.6 °C/km (advanced pilots only).
  • West McClellan: Marginal — Wind on-favored W/NW by 12:00, strong 17–21 mph after 14:00 with 22 mph gusts. Fly 12:30–15:00 for 475 ft/min thermals to 4,000 ft AGL. Sharp thermal caution — lapse rate 9.0 °C/km.
  • Peavine Mountain: Unfavorable — Persistent SW/S wind 13–23 mph all day off preferred direction; peak gusts 23 mph. Brief thermal window 13:00–15:00 to 5,400 ft AGL (505 ft/min). Sharp thermal caution — lapse rate 9.7 °C/km.
  • Rainbow Ridge: Favorable — Light E/NE winds 5–6 mph morning, turning W 12–18 mph afternoon. Fly 11:30–15:00 for 550+ ft/min thermals to 7,400 ft AGL (best ceiling). Sharp thermal caution — lapse rate 10.0 °C/km (advanced pilots only). Hazardous peak directional shear 33° flagged.
  • Duck Hill: Marginal — Morning SE off-direction; wind turns on-favored W 11–21 mph after 14:00. Fly 13:00–16:00 for 460 ft/min thermals to 5,500 ft AGL. Sharp thermal caution — lapse rate 9.7 °C/km. Evening soaring potential 19:00–20:00.
  • Daydreams: Unfavorable — Very weak thermals (peak 131 ft/min) and low ceiling 2,100 ft AGL. Wind on-favored SW in afternoon, but thermal lift is marginal all day.

Hazards

  • Sharp thermals — All sites report lapse rates 8.1–10.0 °C/km (≥8 °C/km implies strong, punchy thermals suitable advanced/expert pilots only). Kingsbury, Hallelujah, McClellan, Rainbow Ridge, and Duck Hill exceed 9.5 °C/km.
  • Low-level shear — Peak layer speed shear exceeds 5 mph/layer at Hallelujah (9 mph @ 420 ft AGL), McClellan (6 mph @ 2,216 ft AGL), Rainbow Ridge (5 mph @ 7,860 ft AGL), and Duck Hill (6 mph @ 1,807 ft AGL). Expect abrupt wind changes near terrain.
  • Directional shear (Rainbow Ridge) — Peak layer directional change of 33° exceeds 30° hazard threshold; watch for turbulence near the top of the boundary layer.
  • Strong afternoon winds — Domain gusts to 31 mph; Kingsbury sees 29 mph steady after 17:00. West-side sites (McClellan, West McClellan, Peavine) exceed 20 mph after 15:00.
  • Rotor/lee turbulence — Westerly flow 15–30 mph downwind of Peavine Mountain and Carson Range ridgelines in afternoon may generate mechanical turbulence.

Site Forecast ?Top of Thermals (PBLH) — height of the turbulent mixing layer; thermals typically reach this ceiling.

Cloud Base — lowest model level with >10% cloud fraction.
w* — convective velocity scale; higher = stronger thermals (ft/min).
Cloud Cover — max cloud fraction over the column (0–100%).
